system_scope.purpose: 사용자 인증, 작업 CRUD, 실시간 업데이트 기능을 갖춘 웹 대시보드입니다.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to log in with email and password.
acceptance_criteria: User can log in with valid credentials.
Invalid credentials show an error message.

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to create an account using email and password.
acceptance_criteria: User can register with valid email and password.
Passwords must match.
Duplicate email addresses show an error message.

features.name: User Logout
features.description: Allow users to log out from their account.
acceptance_criteria: User is logged out successfully.
Invalid or expired token shows an error message.

features.name: Two-Factor Authentication
features.description: Provide an additional layer of security by requiring a second form of verification during login.
acceptance_criteria: User must enter a valid verification code after login.
Invalid verification codes show an error message.

features.name: Create Task
features.description: Allow users to create a new task with details such as title, description, due date, and priority level.
acceptance_criteria: User can create a task with all required fields
Task is saved in the database
Confirmation message is displayed

features.name: Read Task
features.description: Allow users to view details of an existing task by its ID.
acceptance_criteria: User can retrieve task details using a valid task ID
Invalid task ID returns an error message

features.name: Update Task
features.description: Allow users to update the details of an existing task, including title, description, due date, and priority level.
acceptance_criteria: User can update task details with valid inputs
Updated task details are saved in the database
Confirmation message is displayed

features.name: Delete Task
features.description: Allow users to delete an existing task by its ID.
acceptance_criteria: User can delete a task using a valid task ID
Deleted task is removed from the database
Confirmation message is displayed

features.name: Task Update Notifications
features.description: Notify users in real-time when a task is created, updated, or deleted by any user.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive notifications for all task changes in real-time
Notifications contain relevant task details

features.name: Live Task Status Updates
features.description: Provide live updates on the status of tasks being worked on, reflecting changes immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Task status updates are reflected in real-time on the dashboard
Users can see the latest status without refreshing the page

features.name: Real-Time Collaboration
features.description: Enable multiple users to collaborate on tasks in real-time, allowing simultaneous edits and updates.
acceptance_criteria: Users can edit tasks simultaneously without conflicts
Changes are reflected in real-time for all users

features.name: Password Reset
features.description: Allow users to reset their password using their email address.
acceptance_criteria: User receives a reset link for valid email.
Invalid email shows an error message.

features.name: Session Management
features.description: Manage user sessions to ensure security and allow users to stay logged in or log out.
acceptance_criteria: Active session is maintained for valid token.
Expired token shows an error message.

features.name: List Tasks
features.description: Allow users to view a list of all tasks, with options to filter by status, due date, or priority.
acceptance_criteria: User can retrieve a list of tasks based on provided filters
Task list is displayed correctly according to filters

features.name: Real-Time Updates
features.description: Provide users with real-time updates on task changes, such as creation, updates, and deletions.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive notifications for task changes in real time
Notifications are relevant to the user's tasks

features.name: User Activity Feed
features.description: Display a real-time feed of user activities related to tasks, such as comments, edits, and status changes.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view a chronological feed of activities
Feed updates in real-time as new activities occur

features.name: Error Handling for Real-Time Updates
features.description: Implement error handling to manage failures in real-time updates, ensuring users are informed.
acceptance_criteria: Users receive clear error messages when updates fail
System logs errors for further investigation
